subtitle: My pause in pixels
title: Framed Moments
description: Photography is one of my favorite hobbies. I enjoy capturing candid moments from daily life, nature, and surroundings. These photos were taken casually over time using my phone. They reflect my creativity beyond programming and help me see beauty in everyday things. Each picture tells a small story and holds a memory worth keeping. This gallery is a glimpse into how I express myself through visuals, beyond just writing code. It reminds me that creativity lives in both art and logic, and sometimes, a photo speaks more than words.
